USAble Life is seeking Web Developers at the Developer I and Developer II levels to develop, maintain, and test software applications that support its systems and business operations. The role translates business requirements into technical solutions and collaborates with analysts and developers on quality assurance, deployments, and software quality throughout the development lifecycle.
Computer Software
Hiring Manager
Archi Nagwani
Responsibilities
Work with Business Analysts and Lead Developers to identify and document business requirements related to integration processes
Analyze defined system specifications and translate requirements into workable software solutions
Develop, implement, maintain, and test software applications supporting company systems
Recommend practical solutions to processing problems and application issues
Support quality assurance activities, software testing, and deployment processes
Participate in code reviews to provide feedback, learn development best practices, and ensure consistency across applications
Assist with application planning, design, development, and deployment
Communicate work progress and project status proactively to the development team and project stakeholders
Review code to ensure compliance with development standards, coding conventions, and consistency requirements
Apply secure coding practices, object-oriented programming principles, and established design patterns
Perform other related duties and responsibilities as assigned
Participate in rotating on-call responsibilities, including providing support during nighttime hours

Required
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or a curriculum or experience aligned with the required skills
At least 1 year of IT experience for Developer I
At least 2 years of IT experience for Developer II
Equivalent military experience may satisfy the education and experience requirement stated for Developer I
Experience with open-source tools such as log4net, NUnit, and NHibernate
Experience using version control systems such as Git
Experience writing SQL queries on database platforms such as Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, or Oracle
Experience with software development or release tracking tools such as Jira or Targetprocess
Strong understanding of programming concepts, object-oriented programming, secure coding practices, and design patterns
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to work effectively in a team environment
Keen attention to detail and a commitment to software quality
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to manage assigned tasks and deliver work within established timelines
Understanding of software testing tools, unit testing, integration testing, test scripting, and testing methodologies
Preferred
For Developer I: Curriculum or coursework focused on SQL and Microsoft .NET
For Developer I: At least 2 years of IT experience
For Developer I: IT-related experience in the health insurance industry
For Developer II: Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines
For Developer II: At least 3 years of IT experience

Annual incentive plan eligibility based on company and individual performance.
Medical, dental, and vision benefits.
Paid time off provided at the date of hire.
11 paid holidays.
401(k) plan with an employer match of up to 6%, fully vested from the first day.
